24. (1) The Commission shall, within six months of the
end of each financial year, submit to the Minister an annual
report on the activities carried out by the Commission. The
following documents shall be attached to such report-

(a)
the  audited  accounts  of  the  Commission  for  the
year along with the Auditor-General’s report; and

(b)
a  report  of  proposed  activities  for  the  year
immediately following the year to which such report
and accounts relate.
(2) The Minster shall table the annual report along with
the documents specified in subsection (1) in Parliament for
its  consideration.
25.  The  Chairperson  and  members  of  the  Commission
and  the  Director,    officers  and  other  employees  of  the
Commission and every expert consulted by the Commission
under  section  12  and  members  of  committees  or  panels
appointed under section 23, shall, before entering upon his
duties, sign a declaration pledging to observe strict secrecy
